mentions.name: With This Link
mentions.description: This site lets couples create wedding invitation websites where guests can RSVP directly on the invitation. Users get a personalized link for their invitation with different domain options.
mentions.source_excerpt: It's a site for couples to create a wedding invitation website where guests can RSVP right on the invitation. You get a personalized link for an invitation with different domain options.
